independent_unit: one closed centerline file; multiple discretizations of the same file are not independent units
parser_contract: Text files are parsed as one or more XYZ components; blank lines separate components; comments begin with #; an explicitly repeated terminal point is removed before closed-polyline processing.
translator_contract: Coordinates remain in source units during blind scoring. No SST length, density, circulation, particle identity, or mass calibration enters the blind gates.
